claim_boundaries: Rama narrative retained as legend, not origin chronology or maritime-diffusion evidence.
2009 roles and instruments are attributed historical description, not a fixed ensemble for every present group.
2013 organizer account establishes a dated credit and reported writing themes; not independent observation, song transcription, measured audience response or current availability.
No universal community membership rule or performer gender inferred from theatrical roles.
Listening prompts are editorial guidance. No media copied or recording auditioned.
